title: Girls In Hijabs Turned Away From Azerbaijani Schools Amid Protests Over Dress Code
content: A new dress-code dispute in Azerbaijan’s public schools has sparked protests by parents and students after reports that girls wearing hijabs, or Islamic headscarf, were turned away from classes. The protests come after a new ban on clothing deemed incompatible with the secular nature of education.
